description: pnpm quarantines every release for 7 days (minimumReleaseAge + strict), so Renovate waits the same 7 days for npm.
pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds is an allowlist: a new package that needs an install/build script is NOT approved by Renovate. A human must add it to allowBuilds in the PR.

packageRules.description: Match pnpm's 7-day quarantine; otherwise installs fail under minimumReleaseAgeStrict.
Go has no built-in quarantine; a short wait filters yanked and broken tags.
Dev tooling in one PR, automerged when CI is green. Majors fall through to their own PRs.
React runtime and its type packages move together; never automerged.
Renders every page, so a regression hits all users: always its own PR, manual merge.
prBodyNotes: pdfjs-dist renders every page. Run the PDF corpus tests and open a few real PDFs before merging.

packageRules.description: WASM OCR engine: its own PR, manual merge.
Auth SDKs: their own PR, manual merge.
Go minor/patch in one PR, never automerged (runtime deps).
Actions: one PR for version/digest bumps, automerged when CI is green.
Majors: separate PR per package, never grouped, never automerged. Last so it wins.
